title: Velvety Silky Kenyan Coconut Cream Fondue
description: A rich and indulgent Kenyan dish featuring coconut cream, a soffritto-base, and no nuts. Perfect for dipping fresh fruits or cookies.
instructions: Heat the coconut cream in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until warm and fragrant.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent.
Add the lime juice, hot sauce, salt, and cinnamon to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the cocoa powder to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Gradually add the heavy cream to the saucepan, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens slightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and a splash of the warm coconut cream mixture.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm coconut cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the saucepan to the heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and reaches 160°F.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot and keep warm.
To serve, dip fresh fruits or cookies into the fondue and enjoy!
